description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: regions outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the resource group.

title.zh: 透明接入同步用户的ECS、CLB和NLB资产

descriptions.zh: 调用接口后系统会异步执行同步，请使用[DescribeProductInstances](~~2743168~~)接口查询同步结果。
descriptions.en: After you call this operation, the system performs the synchronization asynchronously. You can call the [DescribeProductInstances](~~2743168~~) operation to query the synchronization result.
